description: This file defines an abstract class 'Endpoint' within the OrangeHRM API, specifically for version 2. It provides a structure for handling API requests, including request parameter handling, validation, sorting, and pagination functionalities. It serves as a base class for more specific endpoint implementations in the HRM system.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: An abstract base class for API endpoints, providing common functionality for request handling, validation, sorting, and pagination within the OrangeHRM API v2.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoint with a Request object.

methods.name: init
methods.description: A protected hook method for child classes to override for additional initialization.

methods.name: getRequestParams
methods.description: Returns the RequestParams object associated with the request.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a ValidationDecorator for input validation.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Sets sorting and pagination parameters on the provided FilterParams object based on request query parameters.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules for sorting and pagination parameters, considering allowed sort fields.

methods.name: getAttributeId
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute ID from the request parameters.
